outcome: Prevalence of staircase (Sc) pattern in neonatal line (NNL) of deciduous teeth
Association between Sc prevalence and perinatal circumstances
cohort: 88 deciduous teeth from a prospectively followed population cohort
finding: The prevalence of staircase pattern in the neonatal line of deciduous teeth differed significantly by tooth type and was associated with the ratio of prenatal to total crown enamel.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between staircase pattern prevalence and duration or mode of delivery.
